items.title: Asked Derrick Jones Jr. how Clippers defense can be better than 18th-ranked unit from last season
items.author: Law Murray 📘
items.body_excerpt:
Asked Derrick Jones Jr. how Clippers defense can be better than 18th-ranked unit from last season

DJ mentioned that LAC "didn't lock in on the game plan a lot last year"

Added that "it's tough to have a louder voice than Brook (Lopez)" to carry that message of being better.

items.title: Derrick Jones Jr. on Isaiah Jackson starting: “Honestly, I think he’s one of the fastest big men in the league. He’s up there with me. So, honestly, you have him running one side, me running on the other side, I love our chances. He brings a lot to the table.”
